retrievalProfile.description: A painterly portrait of a young man centered against a stylized suburban neighborhood under a vibrant, textured twilight sky with expressive script lettering.
excludeWhen: minimalist flat vector art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, painterly illustration featuring a central male figure in a white shirt, set against a backdrop of blue-toned suburban houses and a dramatic sky filled with orange and blue clouds. The style mimics traditional oil or acrylic painting with visible brushwork and a soft, glowing light source.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the foreground against a receding suburban landscape
Warm sunset highlights on the face and clouds contrast with cool blue shadows
Dynamic script typography arcs above the subject's head
Low-angle perspective creates a sense of introspection and scale
coreInvariants: Visible painterly texture throughout all surfaces
Soft, diffused lighting with a primary glow from the side
Suburban house silhouettes in the mid-ground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-close-up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes looking off-camera, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, moves upward to the large script title, then follows the horizon line of the houses across the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the composition is dedicated to the sky and typography, providing breathing room for the dense portrait.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blues and teals define the sky and the shadows of the houses.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm oranges, pinks, and yellows in the clouds and skin tones provide a sunset glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the subject's clothing and the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white shirt and the deep blue background; medium saturation in the sky creates a dreamy atmosphere.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh blacks; use deep blues or purples for shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: High-contrast brush strokes with thick downstrokes and thin upstrokes
Fluid, connected characters with expressive flourishes
Tilted axis for a dynamic, hand-written feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated to fill the sky space
The 'B' and 'N' have large, sweeping loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, geometric sans-serif for secondary info paired with a large, expressive brush script for the main title.

preserve: The painterly texture of the letters
The wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: To match the expressive, hand-painted feel of the main title.
For the clean, spaced-out secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly illustration of a young man in a white shirt, centered, looking away. The background should be a suburban street at twilight with blue houses and a textured sky of orange and blue clouds. Apply a canvas texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, hand-painted brush script title in the upper center, slightly arched. Above it, add a secondary name in a small, wide-tracked, white all-caps sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the texture painterly rather than photographic?
Is the script title expressive and brush-like?
Is the color palette dominated by twilight blues and sunset oranges?

mustRedesign: Any photographic elements must be converted to painterly strokes
Flat digital gradients must be replaced with textured brushwork

mustAchieve: Cohesive color harmony between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text feels integrated into the sky texture.
Ensure the subject's skin tones reflect the ambient twilight light.
Verify that the suburban houses are stylized and not overly detailed.
Confirm the white shirt has soft blue and orange shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Painterly Portrait + Suburban Twilight + Expressive Brush Script
